value: Owner: check the legal form; a sole establishment or a branch needs no liquidator and a short notice; the steps below are for an LLC
Owner: pass a notarised resolution to dissolve and appoint a liquidator who is not the recent auditor (Commercial Companies Law Art 302 and 316)
Owner or PRO: register the company as under liquidation with DET
Liquidator: publish the creditor notice in two daily newspapers including one in Arabic; the law requires at least 30 days (Commercial Companies Law Art 324)
Accountant: settle every employee entitlement, then PRO: cancel all work permits and the MOHRE card; the establishment acknowledges all entitlements paid (Cabinet Resolution 1/2022 Art 7(3))
PRO: cancel residence visas, dependants first (or the AED 5,000 guarantee), then the immigration card at GDRFA
Accountant: apply for VAT deregistration within 20 business days of ceasing to be required to register
Accountant: apply for corporate tax deregistration within 3 months of cessation
Owner: obtain clearances from DEWA, telecom, customs, the landlord and the bank
Liquidator: prepare the final account and report once the notice has elapsed and debts are settled; unclaimed amounts are deposited (Commercial Companies Law Art 326 and 330)
Bank: close the account after the final settlements
Owner or PRO: obtain the cancellation from DET; the company becomes closed in the portal
steps.source: Boasis research, licence lifecycle, section 4 (Cancellation / liquidation, mainland LLC: Resolution REPORTED; Register REPORTED; Creditor notice CONFIRMED; Cancel permits CONFIRMED (Sharjah); Cancel visas REPORTED; Clearances REPORTED; VAT and CT deregistration REPORTED; Final account CONFIRMED; Simplified path REPORTED; total 3 to 6 months REPORTED) and Boasis research, mainland employee lifecycle, section 12 (Permit cancellation CONFIRMED; Residency cancellation CONFIRMED); https://bcl.ae/blogs/company-liquidation-dubai/ ; https://egsh.ae/insights/close-business-in-dubai ; https://www.moet.gov.ae/documents/20121/376326/Commercial+Companies.pdf ; https://www.saifaudit.com/blog/2026/06/12/company-liquidation-dubai/ ; https://taxready.ae/vat-deregistration-uae/ ; https://www.mohre.gov.ae/assets/download/46bdbfda/Cabinet%20Resolution%20_Executive%20Regulations%20Decree-Law%20No.%2033.pdf.aspx

value: Owner: pass the partner resolution for the change; a manager change needs the resolution, the IDs and a no-objection letter
Owner or PRO: obtain a no-objection certificate from the regulator when the activity is in a regulated sector
Owner: notarise a memorandum of association addendum when the change touches the memorandum (objects, trade name, partners, legal form); in person or by remote video with UAE PASS
Owner or PRO: for a share transfer, get DET initial approval first, then the notarised transfer and addendum, then submit for reissue
Owner or PRO: submit the amendment online at DET; activity adds, manager swaps and address changes that do not touch the memorandum are online
Owner: for an address change, register the new Ejari first
Owner: update the beneficial owner declaration within 15 days if ownership changed (Cabinet Decision 109/2023)
Owner: upload the amended licence to the portal

value: Owner or PRO: check that a visa slot exists under the MOHRE quota for the premises
Owner and person: e-sign the MOHRE standard job offer (Ministerial Decree 46/2022) before the permit application
PRO: apply for the work permit at MOHRE with the passport, photo, attested qualification for skill levels 1 to 3, the licence and the signed offer
PRO: apply for the employment entry permit at GDRFA Dubai (UAE PASS or Amer); 48 hours; passport valid at least 6 months; AED 200 plus VAT
Person: enter the country, or change status inside the country (AED 500 plus 10 plus 10 plus 15 or 50); residency must be completed within 60 days of entry
Owner: put the health insurance policy in place; it is produced at residence issuance (Dubai Law 11/2013 Art 11(6))
Person, paid by the owner: medical fitness test at a DHA centre via Amer; the certificate is valid three months
PRO: Emirates ID application and biometrics
PRO: residence permit issuance at GDRFA within 60 days of entry, with the medical, the insurance, the work permit and a passport valid at least 6 months
PRO: register the labour contract at MOHRE within 14 days of entry or status change (reported; sources differ on the trigger)
Person: subscribe to unemployment insurance (ILOE); the certificate is required before the labour card is issued (reported)

value: Owner: give the notice in the contract; 30 to 90 days after probation (Art 43), 14 days from the employer during probation (Art 9)
Accountant: compute the final settlement; wages through WPS by the 1st of the month, gratuity within 14 days, permitted deductions within 3 months (Cabinet Resolution 1/2022 Art 29)
PRO: cancel the work permit at MOHRE; fines paid; the establishment acknowledges that all entitlements are paid (Art 7(3))
PRO: cancel the residence at GDRFA, dependants first or the AED 5,000 guarantee; 2 days; AED 50 plus 100
Person: leave or change status within the grace period after cancellation (30, 60, 90 or 180 days by category)
